scope: FIT plus validation only; five fixed folds, 13 validation patients per fold; no outer-test construction or outcomes
checkpoint_selector: exact A1 excluded-patient VLOO S-F1 over epochs 1..30 and NEZ thresholds 0.05..0.95 in steps of 0.05; other 12 patients select, then excluded patient evaluated
optimizer: AdamW; learning rate 0.0001; weight decay 0.001; patient batch size 2; identical source common-parameter initialization and per-epoch shuffle RNG
source_loss: per-patient EZ=2 NEZ=1 weighted BCE, weighted channel mean, then equal patient mean
balanced_loss: per patient 0.5*mean(EZ BCE with NEZ target 0)+0.5*mean(NEZ BCE with NEZ target 1); equal patient mean; no further class weighting
hard_negative_loss: EZ score=-NEZ logit; top min(16,n_NEZ) highest-scoring NEZ detached indices; mean softplus(0.10-positive_score+negative_score) over all EZ x top-NEZ; weight 0.05; equal patient mean
optional_first_positive: run only if B01 and B11 both fail MRR >=+0.010; BCE base is balanced only if Audit A passes; tau=0.10, margin=0.10, weight=0.05; diagnostic only
capacity_base: balanced BCE only if Audit A passes all six quantitative gates; otherwise source BCE; no rank loss
class_gate: delta AUPRC >=0.010; >=4/5 positive AUPRC folds; MRR and Top1 nondecreasing; Macro-F1 and EZ-F1 each >= baseline-0.005. Imbalance correlation descriptive support only.
hard_negative_gate: either matched B01-B00 or B11-B10 has delta MRR >=0.010, delta Top1 >=0.030, delta AUPRC >=-0.005, delta Macro-F1 >=-0.005, >=4/5 positive MRR folds, mean hard-negative margin strictly improves
capacity_gate: either CAP1-CAP0 or CAP2-CAP0 has delta AUPRC >=0.010, >=4/5 positive AUPRC folds, MRR and Top1 nondecreasing, Macro-F1 >= baseline-0.005, and train-validation AUPRC gap increase <0.010 absolute
gap_substantial_increase: candidate FIT-minus-validation AUPRC gap minus CAP0 gap >=0.010 absolute
unit_tests: six analytic invariances plus zero single-class FIT/validation patients required before training
paired_bootstrap: patient-level paired 65 VLOO cases, 10000 resamples, seed42; diagnostic only
